verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official MCP server for AI assistants. Its tools can search and retrieve designs and pages, export them as PNG, JPG or PDF (screenshot-like images), and give access to brand kits and templates. The Connect APIs also sync designs and assets. However, the MCP server is aimed at generating and editing designs, not at handing structured design context to a coding agent. Missing for 10: structured frame/layer data, design variables or tokens, component-to-code mappings, any documented design-to-code workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
